name: lying single straight leg hip extension
description: Lying face down, you lift one straight leg off the floor. It strengthens your glutes and hamstrings with a gentle load on the lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Raise one straight leg a few inches off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top without arching your lower back.
Lower under control and repeat, then switch legs.
